metadata.description: A Claude Code skill that conducts a software project through eight stages with evidence-based gates, for owners who build with AI agents without engineering training

plugins.name: agentic-engineering-principles
plugins.description: Conduct a project through intake, design, plan, build, verify, ship, own and retro: installed skills are called at the right stage, a stage closes only on evidence that a script checks or on an override the owner chose, and the owner proves in a closed-book round that they can explain the result.
